brief.title: Revenue and clients
brief.text: Invoicing averaged ₹5.89 L a month (ex-GST) over Jul 2026–Sep 2026, up 1% on the three months before. Best month Feb 2026 (₹9.85 L); weakest Aug 2026 (₹2.70 L). FY2024-25 ₹44.79 L collected (9 months of bank lines); FY2025-26 ₹50.72 L invoiced (9 months); FY2026-27 ₹35.08 L invoiced (6 months). Top three clients by invoicing: Beta Homes ₹16.33 L (19%); Gamma Infra Private Limited ₹14.39 L (17%); Zeta Lifespaces ₹12.01 L (14%). Together 50% of invoiced revenue.
brief.basis: Zoho sales invoices ex-GST; years before Zoho use bank credits from the finance sheets

brief.title: Overdue collections
brief.text: 10 invoices worth ₹9.24 L were due before 2025-10-05 and no matching payment appears in the bank lines: Beta Homes ₹1.18 L (461 days); Beta Homes ₹1.18 L (449 days); Zeta Lifespaces ₹59.0k (424 days). Another 99 invoices worth ₹79.73 L are past due but cannot be checked: there is no bank statement after 2025-10-05.
brief.basis: 16 of 26 invoices due before 2025-10-05 have a matching bank credit

brief.title: Burn and runway
brief.text: Monthly costs average ₹9.63 L (May 2026, Jun 2026, Jul 2026) against ₹5.89 L invoiced ex-GST in Jul 2026, Aug 2026, Sep 2026: a shortfall of ₹3.74 L a month if every sale is invoiced in Zoho. Runway is not computed: the latest bank balance (₹70.0k) is from 2025-10-07, 368 days old.
brief.basis: Average of the last three complete months of the monthly cost sheet against Zoho invoicing (ex-GST).

brief.title: Margins
brief.text: Operating margin -55% over 13 months (₹75.74 L invoiced ex-GST against ₹1.17 Cr of costs). The package cost model expects 27% on the 4 Month package; 26% on the 4 Month Common package. Costs are not tracked per client, so per-client margin is an estimate.
brief.basis: Zoho invoicing (ex-GST) against the monthly cost sheet for the same months

brief.title: Next filing
brief.text: GSTR-1 for Jul 2026–Sep 2026 is due 2026-10-13. Every past quarterly GST return has an ARN mail.

brief.title: Anomalies to clear
brief.text: 3 invoice numbers never reached finance mail · GSTR-3B default notice (October-November, 2025) · Profession tax show-cause notice · 1 bank entries sit in the CA's suspense ledger · 10 Indian vendor bills do not show our GSTIN.
brief.basis: Invoice sequence, duplicate bills and bank lines, GST portal mail, CA suspense ledger

brief.title: Software, AI and renewals
brief.text: Software and AI tools cost ₹14.2k a month, of which AI ₹0 (owner's tool list). Renewing within 30 days: Synthetic Wi-Fi ₹1.3k on 2026-10-12; Synthetic Workspace ₹2.7k on 2026-10-12; Synthetic Automation $198.00 on 2026-10-12.
brief.basis: Owner's tool list (EA setup handoff, 2 Oct 2026); vendor bills in finance mail

assumptions: New invoicing continues at ₹6.95 L a month incl. GST (average of the last three complete months).
62% of invoicing is collected the month after it is issued (16 of 26 invoices due before 2025-10-05 have a matching bank credit).
Operating costs stay at ₹9.63 L a month (last three months of the monthly cost sheet).
GST collected on invoices (18%) is paid quarterly after the quarter, before input credit.
Invoices issued in the last 60 days (12, ₹9.27 L) are collected over the next three months in the base case; half of them in the downside case. Older invoices without bank evidence are not projected.
The latest known bank balance is ₹70.0k on 2025-10-07; it is too old to be an opening balance.
